questions.question: Which two hobbits do Frodo and Sam collide with in Farmer Maggot's crops?
questions.note: They are stealing vegetables. Short cut to mushrooms.

questions.question: Which ferry do the hobbits use to escape a Black Rider?
questions.note: The Rider reaches the dock just as they push off.

questions.question: What is the name of the inn at Bree?
questions.note: Gandalf told Frodo to meet him there. He never shows.

questions.question: What false name does Frodo give at Bree?
questions.note: Pippin nearly gives the real name away anyway.

questions.question: What do the people of Bree call the ranger Aragorn?
questions.note: He watches Frodo from a dark corner of the inn.

questions.question: How many Ringwraiths hunt Frodo?
questions.note: Nine rings were given to Men. They became the Nazgûl.

questions.question: On what hilltop ruin are the hobbits attacked and Frodo stabbed?
questions.note: The hobbits' cooking fire gives them away.

questions.question: What kind of blade does the Witch-king stab Frodo with?
questions.note: A shard stays in the wound and works toward his heart.

questions.question: In the film, which Elf rides Frodo to Rivendell?
questions.note: In the book it is Glorfindel. The film gives the ride to Arwen.

questions.question: What stops the Ringwraiths at the ford outside Rivendell?
questions.answer: The river floods and sweeps them away
choices: The river floods and sweeps them away
questions.note: Arwen calls the water. The waves take the shape of horses.
